head.reading: **The head must be in frame.** Pose found on 100% of frames with the head visible, 51% with the head masked and 0% with it cropped out; the poses found with the head masked are mostly wrong (frame MAE 26.36° where the gate opened, rep F1 0.4667). Our code never reads the face, but the pose stage does: the MediaPipe person detector anchors on the face and upper body before the landmark model runs, and region tracking cannot start without it.
